description:
Title: Luxury Airplane

You produce airplanes.
While the base model is always the same, your customer likes to pimp their airplane with fancy interior.
You let them decide between a number of 5 different bars, the number of seats, their color, and the amount of water in the toilets of their plane (you can come up with additional stuff).
After you received the specifications you send the requirements to different teams to manufacture the parts.
E.g. manufacturing the vodka bar is done by the Russian team, the whiskey bar is manufactured by an Irish team.
After receiving the individual bits and pieces, the interior of the plane is assembled, and the plane is sent on a test flight.
During the flight you create a test protocol which is sent to you and the customer.
The plane is delivered to the customer, which has to confirm.

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OtherBarRequirements" name="Other bar requirements" sourceRef="SendTask_SendOtherBarRequirements" targetRef="Participant_OtherPartnerTeams"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_SelectToiletWater" name="Select amount of water in toilets"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendSpecifications" name="Send specifications to manufacturer" messageRef="Message_CustomerSpecifications"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_TestProtocolReceived" name="Test protocol received">

    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_AirplaneDelivered" name="Airplane delivered">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_AirplaneDelivered" messageRef="Message_AirplaneDelivered"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_AirplaneManufacturer" name="Airplane Manufacturer Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_SpecificationsReceived" name="Customer specifications received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Specifications" messageRef="Message_CustomerSpecifications"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordSpecifications" name="Record customer specifications"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BarSplit" name="Which bar was chosen?" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendVodkaBarRequirements" name="Send vodka bar requirements to Russian team" messageRef="Message_VodkaBarRequirements"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BarMerge" name="Bar requirements sent" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendRemainingRequirements" name="Send seat, color, toilet water and option requirements to other partner teams" messageRef="Message_RemainingRequirements"/>

    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_OtherBarPartsReceived" name="Other bar parts received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_OtherBarParts" messageRef="Message_OtherBarParts"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BarPartsMerge" name="Bar parts received" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_RemainingPartsReceived" name="Remaining interior parts received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RemainingParts" messageRef="Message_RemainingParts"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PartsJoin" name="All parts received" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleInterior" name="Assemble plane interior"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FlightSplit" name="Flight starts" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductTestFlight" name="Conduct test flight"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendTestProtocol" name="Send test protocol to customer" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_DeliverAirplane" name="Deliver airplane to customer"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_DeliveryConfirmed" name="Delivery confirmation received">

    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

  </bpmn:process>
